killedBy: hud: versus results (n-player arc PR 4 -- FFA + teams, .hud-coop-kills precedent) lists the teams in letter order even when P1 is not on team A
why: Lists the team rows in the order their first slot appears instead of A, B, C. Every fixture where P1 is on team A reads the same either way, so the killer puts P1 on team B; a table that opened on "Team B" would read as B being first or best.
